integrity: An analytical proof and reproducible finite numerical checks are provided. Finite checks are not exhaustive, and no independent audit or external mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the shortest-path metric on all vertices after subdividing every edge of an unweighted complete bipartite graph exactly once. It does not cover partial subdivisions, arbitrary weights, or continuum-edge metric graphs. The eight-cycle boundary is known; the unequal-case exponent is an implicit unique root, and historical priority could be affected by unindexed equivalent results.
title: A balanced–unbalanced transition in the Hilbert snowflakes of fully subdivided bicliques
